facts.title: broccoli rubble farro salad
ingredients: 1 pound broccolini or regular broccoli (previously: 2 pounds, see note)
Finely grated zest, then juice, of 1 lemon
4 ounces pecorino romano, grated or ground in a food processor
facts.yield_text: 2 robust servings or 4 more petite ones
facts.author: Deb Perelman
